visual_name: Day in the life, part fifteen: forty minutes of good light (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js park with a sky driven by a countdown, box-built character, login / nested code dialogs / CAPTCHA / share sheet / home screen / app opening, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.5 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: forty minutes of good light lost to a wrong password, a reset code behind an email behind another code, and a traffic-light CAPTCHA, while the sun sets and a timer hits zero; then YourBrand: sign in once, add it to the home screen, tap the icon, already signed in. She is still not sure she is human.
